intro: Zephaniah warns of the great day of the LORD, in the days of good King Josiah.
Chapter one announces judgement on Judah. Chapter two calls the humble to seek the LORD, and warns the nations.
Chapter three ends with one of the most tender pictures of God in the Bible.
Zephaniah was a descendant of King Hezekiah.
Listen for the last chapter: he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will joy over thee with singing.
